g.text: Config mapping: Git --> ArgoCD --> Helm --> Kubernetes
Follow one service (orders-api in prod) from the first file ArgoCD reads to the objects it creates. Red box = the line that matters, arrow = where that value goes.
1. the ONLY file applied by hand (kubectl apply)
guard rails: which repo, which namespaces, which kinds
2. one file per env/app -> one Application (3 apps x 3 envs = 9)
what the generator produces for environments/prod/orders-api.yaml
3. ONLY what prod changes. Deploy = edit tag/digest + git push
anything the env file does not set comes from here
4. templates turn values into Kubernetes objects
5. where the secret value really lives (never in Git on EKS)
fake: # EKS: aws SecretsManager, same name
only ArgoCD may change objects in a protected namespace
Prometheus picks up ServiceMonitors from every namespace
only these kinds may be created
